description:
Discover the 2024 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid Select, a sophisticated family vehicle designed to deliver reliability, comfort, and practical value for your everyday journeys.

- Hybrid powertrain with 3.6L V6 engine and CVT transmission
- Uconnect 5 Nav with 10.1" touchscreen display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM 360L satellite radio
- Navigation system with parking camera
- Heated front seats and heated steering wheel
- Leatherette bucket seats with driver memory settings
- Automatic temperature control with front and rear dual-zone A/C
- Power liftgate for convenient access
- Heavy duty suspension with four-wheel independent setup
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Multiple airbags including front, side, knee, and overhead protection
- Reclining third-row seats with split-folding configuration
- 17" diamond-cut alloy wheels
- Rear window defroster and rain-sensing wipers

The Pacifica Hybrid combines thoughtful engineering with everyday practicality. The hybrid system works efficiently to help reduce fuel consumption while maintaining the power and capability you need for family trips and daily driving. The interior welcomes you with comfortable seating for up to seven passengers, allowing flexible configurations to accommodate cargo or additional passengers as your needs change.

Climate control technology keeps everyone comfortable, with individual temperature zones for front passengers and dedicated rear air conditioning. The heated steering wheel and heated front seats provide welcome warmth during cooler months. Premium audio features including six speakers and SiriusXM satellite radio deliver quality entertainment throughout your commute.

Safety is thoughtfully integrated throughout this vehicle. Multiple airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to provide confidence on the road. The rear parking camera displays on your navigation screen, helping you navigate tight spaces with clarity. A low tire pressure warning system ensures you maintain optimal tire conditions for safe, efficient driving.

The exterior presents a clean, professional appearance with white paint and body-color bumpers. Heated door mirrors with integrated turn signals, automatic headlights with delay-off functionality, and front fog lights enhance visibility and safety. The power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading, particularly valuable when managing family cargo.

Inside, practical touches meet refined comfort. The telescoping tilt steering wheel adjusts to your preference, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road. Illuminated cupholders, vanity mirrors in front and rear, and overhead console storage provide convenient organization throughout the cabin.

This 2024 Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid Select represents a balanced choice for families seeking a capable minivan with hybrid efficiency, comprehensive safety features, and the comfort technology that makes daily driving more enjoyable. We invite you to experience how this vehicle supports your lifestyle.

This 2020 Chrysler Pacifica Limited combines family-friendly versatility with refined comfort features. The spacious three-row seating accommodates your entire family, while the power liftgate and split-folding rear seats make loading and reconfiguring cargo simple and convenient. The gray exterior presents a sophisticated appearance that complements various settings, from everyday use to special occasions.

Inside, you'll find Premium Leather Trim Bucket Seats that provide comfort for both driver and passengers. Heated front and rear seats keep occupants comfortable during colder months, while ventilated front seats offer relief during warmer weather. The heated steering wheel adds another layer of personal comfort, and the power moonroof brings natural light to the cabin.

Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity allows you to access your smartphone applications directly. Safety features include a ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and a comprehensive airbag system with front dual, front side, knee, and overhead airbags. The 3.6L V6 engine delivers capable performance paired with a 9-Speed 948TE Automatic transmission that achieves an EPA-estimated 19 city and 28 highway miles per gallon. Dual front and rear zone air conditioning, automatic temperature control, and a rear window defroster ensure comfort in all seasons. Memory seats, power-adjustable steering, and extensive driver assist features come together to create an accommodating driving environment.

This Pacifica Limited represents a comprehensive family vehicle offering practical features, modern technology, and dependable comfort for your daily transportation needs.

description:
Discover the 2018 Honda Odyssey EX-L with Navigation & Rear Entertainment System, a versatile minivan designed for families and daily commutes alike. Dressed in striking White Orchid Pearl with a spacious beige interior, this used van offers 88,768 miles of reliable performance. Powered by a 3.5-liter V6 engine producing 280 horsepower and 262 lb-ft of torque, it delivers smooth acceleration with a 9-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive. Its fuel economy stands at 19 mpg city and 28 mpg highway, making it efficient for long drives and city errands. The Odyssey’s thoughtfully designed interior accommodates up to eight passengers, with comfortable heated seats, memory seat settings, and a sunroof for added comfort and style. Modern convenience features include Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, a push-start button, keyless entry, and rear air conditioning, ensuring every journey is connected and comfortable. Safety is enhanced with adaptive cruise control, a backup camera, blind spot monitoring, lane keep assist, collision warning, cross traffic alert, and fog lights, making it a dependable choice for family safety.

This 2018 Honda Odyssey also impresses with a comprehensive suite of entertainment and technology features. An 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system with HD radio, SiriusXM satellite radio compatibility, and Pandora internet radio app keep you connected and entertained on the go. The audio system includes six speakers and a subwoofer, with auxiliary USB input and electronic messaging assistance with a read function, ensuring your favorite tunes and messages are always within reach. The intuitive touch screen display simplifies control of media and navigation, providing a seamless driving experience. Whether commuting or road-tripping, this Odyssey offers a blend of advanced technology and comfort for everyone on board.

2018 Honda Odyssey Safety and Security Features

The Odyssey prioritizes safety with dual front knee airbags and four-wheel ABS to help prevent accidents and protect occupants. Power door locks feature auto-locking and anti-lockout functions, giving added security. Cornering brake control enhances stability during turns, especially in adverse conditions. The vehicle also includes an electronic parking brake with auto-off, simplifying parking maneuvers and ensuring safety when stationary.

2018 Honda Odyssey Entertainment and Technology Features

Entertainment is at the forefront with an HD radio and a responsive 8-inch touch screen display. The infotainment system supports auxiliary audio input via USB, while a total of six speakers and a dedicated subwoofer deliver clear, immersive sound. Additional features include electronic messaging assistance with a read function and access to Pandora internet radio, keeping you connected and entertained wherever you travel.

2018 Honda Odyssey Performance Features

The Odyssey’s engine incorporates cylinder deactivation technology, optimizing fuel efficiency by shutting down cylinders when full power isn’t needed. This feature helps balance performance and economy, making the van an efficient choice for everyday driving and extended trips.

2018 Dodge Grand Caravan SE * 1 Owner * 32K Original Miles * 283 Hp 6 Cylinder Engine * Dual Sliding Side Doors * Rear View Camera * 25 Mpg * New PA Safety Inspection * Free Warranty * Excellent Condition * Easy Instant Financing!

Sale Price Includes a Standard $490 PA Dealer Documentary Fee

If your priority has more to do with a low-cost way of shuttling your family vs. having the latest amenities and safety and tech features in your minivan, the Dodge Grand Caravan is suitable transportation.

Although not providing as many features, the 2018 Dodge Grand Caravan marches on alongside newer and more sophisticated minivans such as the Honda Odyssey, Toyota Sienna, Kia Sedona, and its own corporate cousin, the Chrysler Pacifica. Dodge s Grand Caravan does boast a powerful V6 engine, nifty Stow n Go seats and a significantly lower price point that provides excellent value for comfortable, reliable family transportation.

Driving The Used 2018 Dodge Grand Caravan Passenger

The Dodge Grand Caravan isn t exactly exciting to drive, but that shouldn t be a surprise considering the segment it s in. With the possible exception of the Honda Odyssey, few minivans can be called all that interesting to drive, and that s pretty much the point. These vehicles are for ferrying family and friends, not tempting fate or testing the local authorities. Those caveats out of the way, owners can at least attest to the Grand Caravan minivan s power. Its standard V6 provides good straight-line acceleration, so you needn t fear that freeway onramp. If there s one other endearing ride quality, it s this family vehicle s soft, comfortable ride.

Interior Comfort

This Dodge Grand Caravan seats seven passengers. The bench seat in the second row seats two and the third row seats three. Compared to rivals, the Grand Caravan s interior feels simplistic but is quite functional. Highlights are its standard Stow n Go 2nd-row seats that fold into the floor to create a flat load space. Up front are basic controls for climate, and a standard 6.5-inch touch-screen infotainment system.

Exterior Styling

Styling of the Dodge Grand Caravan might be called conservative by an optimist or plain by a pessimist. Either way, it s safe to say it doesn t have the stylistic flair of the latest Honda Odyssey or Chrysler Pacifica. Your eyes will know if they like it when they see it, and if you re not trying to make a fashion statement but simply transport your loved ones in a new and roomy vehicle, then this Dodge can fit the bill. Basic models have manual-sliding side doors and manual tailgate.

Favorite Features

3.6-LITER V6 ENGINE

This V6 has well-served a variety of Dodge and Chrysler vehicles, and it impresses here again in the Grand Caravan. It earns a respectable 25 mpg on the highway, and is even rated to tow 3,600 pounds.

LOW PRICE

For many used-car buyers, the Dodge Grand Caravan s biggest appeal is its price. It is the least expensive minivan in its segment.

Standard Features

This 2018 Grand Caravan minivan comes with pretty basic features such a urethane steering wheel, manual-adjust cloth seats and steel wheel covers. It does at least have 3-zone climate control, rearview camera, auto-dimming rearview mirror and the Stow n Go seats. The basic infotainment system is a 6.5-inch touch-screen unit with CD/DVD player, radio and hard-disc drive for storing music.

Engine & Transmission

The 2018 Dodge Grand Caravan is powered by a 3.6-liter V6 engine good for 283 horsepower and 260 lb-ft of torque. Known as the Pentastar, it s a laudable engine, delivering smooth power and pretty good fuel economy. The engine is paired to a 6-speed automatic transmission that delivers smooth shift action and, unlike some other transmissions in other vehicles, doesn t have the annoying characteristic of continually hunting for the correct gear. Finally, the V6 is E85-compatible, so it can operate on blends of gasoline and ethanol. The Grand Caravan is front-wheel drive just like all of its rivals.

This 2018 Chrysler Pacifica Touring Plus is trimmed in White with a well-appointed interior and is powered by a 3.6L V6 24V VVT engine with 9-Speed Automatic FWD transmission.

- S Appearance Package with Black Badging and Premium Fascia
- Uconnect 4C Navigation with 8.4" Touchscreen Display
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with Traffic Plus and Travel Link Services
- 20" x 7.5" Aluminum Black Noise Wheels
- Single Rear Overhead DVD System with 10" LCD Screen
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Compatibility
- Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection
- ParkSense Rear Park Assist with Back-Up Camera
- Leather Wrapped Steering Wheel
- Front Dual Zone Automatic Climate Control
- Power Liftgate
- Black Stow N Place Roof Rack

This Pacifica delivers dependable performance with its 3.6L V6 engine, achieving 19 MPG in the city and 28 MPG on the highway. The well-designed cabin combines comfort with functionality, featuring cloth bucket seats with S branding, a power-adjustable driver's seat, and comprehensive climate control throughout all three rows. Entertainment options are extensive, including the 8.4" Uconnect navigation system with integrated smartphone connectivity and the single rear overhead DVD system perfect for keeping passengers engaged during longer trips.

Safety remains a priority with dual front and side impact airbags, electronic stability control, four-wheel independent suspension, and the comprehensive Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection system. The ParkSense rear park assist with integrated back-up camera provides confidence when maneuvering in tight spaces. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS technology round out the protective features.

The S Appearance Package elevates the exterior with distinctive black badging, black day light opening moldings, body-color door handles, and the striking 20" aluminum wheels finished in black noise. The black Chrysler grille wing badge and rear spear applique complete the refined appearance. Premium Falken tires ensure reliable traction and handling in various driving conditions.

Interior convenience touches abound with illuminated entry, telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjustability, garage door transmitter integration, and a trip computer display. The overhead console adds organizational capability, while remote keyless entry and the security system provide peace of mind.

This vehicle has passed a comprehensive 116-point inspection, confirming its condition and readiness for the road ahead. The 2018 Pacifica Touring Plus represents a practical family minivan that balances capability, comfort, and modern conveniences for today's active households.

This 2018 Honda Odyssey EX-L offers the practicality and comfort your family deserves in a vehicle engineered for modern life.

- 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC engine with 9-Speed Automatic transmission
- 7-speaker SiriusXM audio system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Front dual zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning
- Heated leather front bucket seats with power adjustment and memory settings
- Power moonroof for enhanced cabin ambiance
- Blind Spot Information System warning for added safety awareness
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- 18 silver-painted alloy wheels
- Front fog lights with auto high-beam headlights
- Split-folding rear seat and reclining 3rd row seat for flexible cargo space
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- Full suite of dual front impact and side impact airbags

This minivan delivers fuel efficiency with an estimated 19 city and 28 highway MPG, allowing you to travel confidently without constant stops at the pump. The 3.5L V6 engine provides adequate power for highway merging and everyday driving situations, while the nine-speed automatic transmission optimizes performance across varied driving conditions.

The EX-L trim reflects a commitment to comfort and convenience. Heated leather seating throughout the front creates a welcoming environment during colder months, while the power passenger seat and memory drivers seat ensure each occupant finds their ideal driving position. The automatic dual-zone climate control system maintains separate temperatures for driver and passenger, and rear air conditioning keeps rear passengers comfortable on longer journeys.

Safety features are comprehensive and purposeful. The Blind Spot Information System provides visual warnings when vehicles enter your blind spots, helping you make confident lane changes. Four-wheel independent suspension contributes to stable handling, while Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control help maintain composure in challenging driving conditions. A full array of airbags, including front, side, and knee protection, works alongside four-wheel disc brakes with ABS to provide multi-layered collision protection.

Technology integration enhances daily usability. The SiriusXM audio system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility keeps you connected to navigation, music, and communications without distraction. The HomeLink garage door transmitter eliminates the need for separate remotes, and the rear window camera provides visual guidance during parking maneuvers.

With 89,714 miles on the odometer, this Odyssey represents genuine value for buyers seeking a well-equipped family vehicle ready for the road ahead. We invite you to visit our showroom, sit behind the wheel, and discover how this minivan can serve your familys transportation needs.

This Odyssey's 3.5L V6 engine delivers dependable performance across diverse driving environments, offering 19 city MPG and 28 highway MPG for efficiency-conscious owners. The nine-speed automatic transmission provides smooth power delivery while optimizing fuel economy for long-distance travel and daily commutes alike.

This Odyssey has been certified, meaning it has been thoroughly inspected and meets stringent quality standards, providing you with confidence in your investment and peace of mind on the road.

This 2018 Honda Odyssey EX-L in Silver delivers the practicality and comfort your family needs for daily driving and weekend adventures. With its spacious three-row seating configuration and split-bench third row, this minivan accommodates up to eight passengers, making it an ideal choice for large families or those who frequently transport groups. The 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 9-Speed Automatic transmission provides reliable performance while achieving 19 city and 28 highway MPG, balancing efficiency with the capability to handle your full schedule.

The cabin reflects genuine attention to comfort and convenience. Heated front bucket seats with premium leather trim keep occupants comfortable in cooler weather, while dual-zone front air conditioning and rear air conditioning ensure every passenger rides in their preferred climate. The power moonroof adds brightness and an open-air feel to the interior, and the leather steering wheel with mounted audio controls puts command at your fingertips.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily routine through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, allowing you to access navigation, music, and messaging apps directly from the vehicle. The SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained across long drives, while the HomeLink garage door transmitter adds convenience when arriving home. Safety features include a blind spot information system, automatic high-beam headlights, and a rearview parking camera to assist with visibility and awareness.

Comfort and accessibility extend throughout the vehicle. The power liftgate opens automatically for easy loading and unloading, while the power driver seat with memory settings allows you to save your preferred driving position. Dual-zone automatic temperature control and a rear window defroster provide comprehensive climate management, and remote keyless entry grants quick access from any distance.

The EX-L trim combines practicality with refinement. Eighteen-inch silver-painted alloy wheels enhance the exterior appearance, heated door mirrors defrost in winter conditions, and a comprehensive suite of safety airbags throughout the cabin protects your passengers. The vehicle features a clean CarFax history, providing assurance of its condition and maintenance record.

This Honda Odyssey represents solid transportation for families who value reliability, space, and thoughtful amenities. Schedule your test drive today and discover how this minivan can enhance your family's mobility and comfort.

This 2018 Honda Odyssey Elite offers the practical sophistication and refined comfort that family travel demands.

- Rear Entertainment System with DVD-Audio
- Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Blind Spot Information System
- Power Liftgate with programmable height
- Heated and Ventilated Front Bucket Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Power Moonroof
- 550-Watt Premium Audio System with 11 speakers and SiriusXM
- Memory Driver Seat and Power Passenger Seat
- HomeLink Garage Door Transmitter
- Exterior Parking Camera with Rear View
- 19" Machine-Finished Alloy Wheels
- Automatic Temperature Control with Front and Rear Dual Zone A/C
- Clean Carfax

The cabin presents a thoughtfully designed environment where every detail supports comfortable travel. Leather seat trim and heated and ventilated front bucket seats create an inviting space for the driver and front passenger. The three-row configuration includes a split-bench third row that reclines, accommodating up to eight passengers while providing flexibility for cargo when needed. Power windows, power door mirrors, and a power moonroof deliver convenient control throughout the vehicle.

Technology and safety integrate seamlessly into your driving experience. The Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System guides you with precision, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto provide familiar smartphone connectivity. The Blind Spot Information System adds an extra layer of awareness on the road. A rearview parking camera displays on the center screen to assist with backing maneuvers, and the HomeLink transmitter eliminates fumbling with multiple remotes at your garage.

Entertainment options keep passengers engaged throughout longer drives. The rear entertainment system with DVD-Audio player and dual wireless headphones means rear passengers can watch movies or listen to content independently. For front passengers, a 550-watt premium audio system with AM/FM, HD Radio, and SiriusXM satellite radio delivers quality sound, controlled conveniently through steering wheel-mounted buttons.

The driving experience reflects Honda's commitment to refined performance. The 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission delivers responsive acceleration with an estimated 19 miles per gallon in the city and 28 on the highway. Electronic Stability Control and a four-wheel independent suspension keep the minivan steady through various road conditions. Speed-sensing steering and rain sensing wipers adjust automatically to your driving circumstances.

Standard safety features provide comprehensive protection for everyone aboard. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags work together with ABS brakes and brake assist. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and occupant sensing airbags round out the protective systems. The HondaLink emergency communication system connects you to assistance when needed.

The Elite trim reflects attention to quality and functionality. A power moonroof brings natural light and openness to the cabin, while fully automatic headlights adjust based on ambient conditions. Interior conveniences include illuminated entry, overhead console storage, and a compass integrated into the rear-view mirror. Power steering and automatic climate control with rear air conditioning ensure comfort for all rows.

This 2018 Honda Odyssey Elite represents a compelling choice for buyers seeking a well-appointed minivan with proven Honda reliability. Contact us today to schedule a test drive and experience firsthand how this vehicle can serve your family's transportation needs.

This 2018 Honda Odyssey EX-L w/Navigation and Rear Entertainment System combines practical family transport with comfortable amenities for every journey.

The Odyssey has earned its place as a dependable family hauler, and this example continues that tradition. Its 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission delivers balanced performance while returning 19 mpg city and 28 mpg highway. The spacious interior accommodates seven passengers with split-folding rear seating that adapts to your needs, whether transporting a full family or maximizing cargo capacity.

Automatic climate control with separate front and rear zones keeps everyone comfortable regardless of season. Heated leather front seats provide warmth during colder months, while the power moonroof adds an open-air option when weather permits. The reclining third-row seat gives rear passengers additional relaxation options on longer trips.

Technology integration makes modern driving easier. The navigation system guides you reliably to your destination, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto put your smartphone's capabilities within reach. The SiriusXM-equipped audio system delivers entertainment options to the entire cabin through seven speakers. The HomeLink transmitter handles garage door operation without fumbling for remotes.

Safety receives appropriate attention with features designed to protect occupants. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain predictable handling. The rear camera aids parking precision, while the Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles in adjacent lanes. A comprehensive airbag system includes front impact, side impact, knee, and overhead protection.

The black exterior presents a clean appearance, complemented by body-color bumpers and silver-painted alloy wheels. Fully automatic headlights with delay-off function and front fog lights enhance visibility, while the rear window wiper maintains clear glass in all conditions. The power liftgate makes loading and unloading convenient, particularly when your hands are full.

This Odyssey represents solid value for a family seeking dependable transportation with meaningful comfort and safety features. We invite you to examine this vehicle in person and experience its practical strengths firsthand.

This 2018 Chrysler Pacifica Touring Plus offers the practical space and comfort your family deserves, with a design built to handle the demands of modern life.

- 8-passenger seating capacity with reclining third-row seat
- Single Rear Overhead DVD System with 10" LCD screen
- Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection
- ParkSense Rear Park Assist with Stop
- Remote Start System
- Power Liftgate
- Uconnect 4 with 7" touchscreen display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Automatic temperature control with front and rear A/C zones
- Four-wheel independent suspension with Touring Suspension tuning
- 18" x 7.5" Painted Aluminum Wheels with Nexen Brand Tires
- Security Alarm with KeySense
- Dual front airbags, side impact airbags, and knee airbag protection

The 3.6L V6 engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission delivers capable performance while returning 19 mpg in city driving and 28 mpg on the highway. The front-wheel-drive layout provides confident handling in varied driving conditions, and the touring suspension is calibrated to balance comfort with responsive control.

Inside, you'll find well-appointed cloth bucket front seats with power adjustment on the driver's side, along with an armrest for added comfort during longer drives. The spacious interior accommodates eight passengers across three rows, with a split-folding rear seat that adapts to your cargo needs. The overhead DVD system keeps passengers entertained on extended trips, while Uconnect 4 with its 7-inch display keeps you connected through Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and SiriusXM Satellite Radio.

Safety features include Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection to alert you to vehicles in adjacent lanes, ParkSense Rear Park Assist with automatic stop functionality, and a ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera to enhance visibility when reversing. The security system and Remote Start feature add convenient peace of mind for your daily routine.

The gray exterior pairs with practical 18-inch painted aluminum wheels wrapped in Nexen Brand tires, presenting a balanced appearance suited to family transportation. Automatic headlights, front fog lights, and a rear window defroster ensure improved visibility in changing weather conditions.

With 72,067 miles on the odometer, this Pacifica Touring Plus represents a solid midpoint in its lifecycle, offering years of remaining service life. The combination of family-oriented features, proven reliability, and practical design makes this vehicle a worthwhile addition to your household. We invite you to schedule a test drive and confirm that this Pacifica meets your family's transportation needs.

description:
This 2015 Honda Pilot LX in Gray offers a practical and capable three-row SUV designed to meet the needs of families and individuals who value versatility and reliability.

- 7-speaker AM/FM/CD audio system with steering wheel mounted controls
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C and rear air conditioning
- Rear window defroster and speed-sensing wipers for enhanced visibility
- Remote keyless entry and delay-off headlights for convenience
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control for secure handling
- Four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering
- Rear parking camera for added safety during reversing
- Power windows, door mirrors, and telescoping steering wheel
- Dual front impact airbags and dual front side impact airbags
- Three rows of seating with split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo space
- Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and brake assist
- Front and rear anti-roll bars for improved stability
- Occupant sensing airbag and anti-whiplash front head restraints
- Tilt steering wheel and trip computer
- 17-inch steel wheels

The cabin provides comfortable seating for up to eight passengers with front bucket seats and a fabric interior. The split-folding rear seat configuration allows you to adjust the cargo area based on your needs, whether you're transporting passengers or larger items. Power steering and speed-sensitive steering make maneuvering smooth and responsive in various driving conditions.

Safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system to protect occupants. The rear parking camera assists with visibility when backing up, and the brake assist system helps optimize stopping power when needed. Anti-whiplash front head restraints provide additional protection during impacts.

This Pilot delivers practical four-wheel independent suspension combined with front and rear anti-roll bars to help maintain composure on different road surfaces. The 3.5L V6 engine produces adequate power for daily driving, paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive. The vehicle achieves 18 city MPG and 25 highway MPG, providing reasonable fuel efficiency for a three-row SUV.

The exterior features body-color bumpers and bodyside moldings for a cohesive appearance, while automatic delay-off headlights make nighttime driving more convenient. Speed-sensitive wipers and a rear window wiper enhance visibility in various weather conditions.

We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this versatile family SUV firsthand. Our team is ready to answer your questions and discuss how this Pilot can serve your transportation needs.

Plus TT&L. Prices include $225 dealer doc fee, $499 Forever Start, and $499 LoJack 1-Year.

The 2018 Ford EcoSport Titanium is a compact SUV for buyers who want maximum convenience from a small footprint. Finished in Diamond White with leather seating and showing 89,530 miles, this Titanium combines easy maneuverability with a surprisingly useful upright cabin. It is particularly well suited to crowded Tampa-area parking, commuting through Wesley Chapel or New Tampa, and buyers who prefer an elevated seating position without stepping into the size and running costs of a larger crossover.

This vehicle uses Ford's 1.0-liter EcoBoost turbocharged three-cylinder engine with a six-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive. For urban and suburban use, that compact size is one of the vehicle's strongest practical advantages.

Titanium was the most feature-focused EcoSport trim in the U.S. lineup for 2018. Ford's published equipment for the model includes leather-trimmed heated front seating, an eight-inch SYNC 3 touchscreen, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, navigation, a premium B&O Play audio system, Intelligent Access with push-button start, automatic climate control, rain-sensing wipers, and a power moonroof. Blind Spot Information System with Cross-Traffic Alert was also part of the Titanium equipment package, giving this small SUV a technology level that was unusual for its class when new.

The cabin's upright architecture creates useful headroom and helps make entry and exit easy. A split-folding rear seat expands the cargo area when passenger capacity is not the priority, and the side-hinged rear cargo door gives the EcoSport a distinctive layout. Leather seating and the Titanium trim details add a more finished feel than the EcoSport's entry-level versions.

SYNC 3 remains one of the most useful ownership features because it places phone, audio, and navigation functions on a clear central touchscreen. Smartphone integration makes it easy to use current mapping and media applications even as technology changes over time.
The premium audio system adds another layer of comfort for longer drives, while automatic climate control and heated front seats make the cabin easier to tailor to individual preferences.

Safety equipment includes multiple airbags, electronic stability and traction control, a rearview camera, tire-pressure monitoring, and the Titanium's blind-spot and cross-traffic monitoring technology. These systems are particularly useful for the exact environments where a compact SUV tends to spend most of its time: parking lots, multilane city roads, and busy suburban traffic.

This EcoSport qualifies as Ford Blue Certified under the established automatic rules. The Blue Certified program provides a 139-point inspection, a 90-day/4,000-mile Comprehensive Limited Warranty, 24/7 Roadside Assistance, and applicable FordPass Rewards Points. That certification is a valuable addition for an older-model vehicle that remains within the program's mileage qualification.

Parks Plus contributes paint, headlight, and interior-surface protection along with anti-theft VIN etching, roadside assistance, identity-theft protection and restoration, stolen-vehicle assistance, collision loyalty credit, cabin sanitizer, and antimicrobial protectant. The uploaded dealer record also shows a clean CARFAX history.

This Diamond White EcoSport Titanium is not trying to be a large family SUV. Its appeal is different: premium small-SUV equipment, leather seating, strong connectivity, easy parking, and flexible cargo space in a vehicle that is genuinely compact. The ParkView rear back-up camera and rear parking sensors simplify maneuvering in tight spaces.

This Grand Cherokee Limited is ready to serve your needs with the dependability and style that defines this respected nameplate. We invite you to schedule your test drive today and discover why this vehicle deserves a place in your driveway.

This 2018 Ford Escape SEL combines practical design with thoughtful amenities that make every drive more enjoyable and connected.

- Panoramic Vista Roof with power open/close and power shade
- Voice-Activated Touchscreen Navigation System with pinch-to-zoom capability

You'll appreciate the straightforward driving experience with 22 city and 28 highway MPG, making this Escape practical for both daily commutes and weekend adventures. The responsive steering and suspension work together to create a composed ride across varying terrain and road conditions.

Inside, the heated leather front seats and dual zone climate control create a comfortable environment regardless of the season. The power driver seat allows you to find your ideal driving position with ease. Dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger satisfaction, while rear window defroster and heated mirrors add convenience during winter months.

Technology integration keeps you connected and informed. The voice-activated touchscreen navigation system responds to your commands, while SiriusXM Radio with a five-year prepaid subscription provides entertainment options. SYNC Connect and 911 Assist offer additional peace of mind, and AppLink compatibility with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto seamlessly integrates your smartphone for navigation and entertainment.

Safety features provide confidence on every journey. Nine airbags are strategically positioned throughout the cabin, complemented by Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, and four-wheel independent suspension. The rear parking sensors and exterior parking camera assist with maneuvering in tight spaces, while brake assist and ABS brakes enhance stopping capability.

This 2018 Ford Escape SEL is ready to serve your transportation needs with style, comfort, and dependable performance. We invite you to visit our showroom to examine this well-equipped crossover and take it for a test drive.

This 2018 Jeep Cherokee Trailhawk delivers the capability and comfort you need for both daily driving and adventure. With its powerful 3.2L V6 engine, 4-wheel drive system, and off-road suspension, this vehicle is built to handle diverse terrain and weather conditions while maintaining the refinement expected in a modern SUV.

- Cold Weather Group with engine block heater, remote start system, heated front seats, and heated steering wheel
- Comfort/Convenience Group including power liftgate and security alarm
- Uconnect 3C Navigation system with 8.4" touchscreen display
- GPS navigation with 5-year SiriusXM Traffic and Travel Link services
- Power front and fixed rear full sunroof
- Off-road suspension for enhanced capability
- Remote start system for convenient vehicle access
- ParkView rear backup camera for safer reversing
- Automatic temperature control with dual front zone air conditioning
- 17" black painted aluminum wheels
- Rear window defroster and front fog lights

Inside, you'll find cloth and leather bucket seating with a front center armrest and split-folding rear seat that adapts to your cargo needs. The cabin features several convenience touches including a leather shift knob, tilt and telescoping steering wheel, and comprehensive gauges with compass and trip computer. Multiple airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to provide peace of mind on the road.

The Trailhawk's practical design includes excellent visibility through the sunroof and numerous windows, along with the backup camera for reversing confidence. The security alarm and remote keyless entry provide essential protection and convenience for your vehicle. The roof rack with rails offers flexibility for carrying additional gear when needed.

This 2018 Cherokee Trailhawk represents a well-equipped SUV ready to meet your transportation needs. Whether you're navigating city streets or exploring less-traveled roads, this vehicle delivers the capability, comfort, and technology to get you where you're going.

2013 Toyota Highlander Limited AWD Vehicle DescriptionIntroduction

The 2013 Toyota Highlander Limited AWD is a premium midsize SUV that offers exceptional comfort, proven reliability, powerful performance, and outstanding versatility. As the top-of-the-line Limited trim, it comes loaded with luxury amenities, advanced technology, and Toyota's dependable All-Wheel Drive system, making it an excellent choice for families and drivers who value confidence, comfort, and long-term durability.

With three rows of seating, a refined V6 engine, upscale interior, and impressive cargo capacity, the Highlander Limited is built to handle everything from daily commuting to family vacations and weekend adventures.

Performance

  • Engine: 3.5-Liter DOHC V6

  • Horsepower: 270 HP

  • Torque: 248 lb-ft

  • Transmission: 5-Speed Automatic Transmission

  • Drivetrain: Full-Time All-Wheel Drive (AWD)

  • Fuel Economy: Up to 17 MPG City / 22 MPG Highway

  • Hill Start Assist Control

  • Downhill Assist Control

  • Tow Package

  • Maximum Towing Capacity: Up to 5,000 lbs (Properly Equipped)

The Highlander Limited is powered by Toyota's proven 3.5-liter V6 engine, delivering smooth acceleration, dependable performance, and excellent towing capability. The full-time AWD system enhances traction and stability in rain, snow, and other challenging road conditions, providing added confidence wherever your journey takes you.

Its refined suspension offers a quiet, comfortable ride while maintaining responsive handling and excellent highway stability.

Interior & Comfort

  • Seating for Up to 7 Passengers

  • Premium Leather-Appointed Seating

  • Heated Front Seats

  • Power Driver's Seat with Memory

  • Power Front Passenger Seat

  • Tri-Zone Automatic Climate Control

  • Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel

  • Power Moonroof

  • Third-Row Seating

  • Fold-Flat Second and Third Rows

  • Power Liftgate

Step inside the Highlander Limited and experience a spacious, well-appointed cabin designed for maximum comfort. Premium leather seating, soft-touch materials, and elegant woodgrain-style trim create a refined atmosphere for every passenger.

Heated front seats, memory settings for the driver's seat, and tri-zone climate control ensure everyone rides comfortably, while the third-row seating provides room for the whole family.

Technology & Infotainment

  • JBL Premium Audio System

  • Touchscreen Display

  • Navigation System

  • Bluetooth Hands-Free Calling

  • Bluetooth Audio Streaming

  • SiriusXM Satellite Radio Capability

  • USB & Auxiliary Inputs

  • Rearview Backup Camera

  • Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls

  • Smart Key System with Push Button Start

  • Voice Recognition

The Highlander Limited is equipped with premium technology to keep you connected and entertained. The touchscreen infotainment system features built-in navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, and a premium JBL audio system that delivers outstanding sound quality.

Smart Key with Push Button Start provides added convenience, while the rearview backup camera makes parking and reversing easier.

Safety & Driver Assistance

  • Rearview Backup Camera

  • Vehicle Stability Control (VSC)

  • Traction Control (TRAC)

  • Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS)

  • Electronic Brake Force Distribution (EBD)

  • Brake Assist

  • Hill Start Assist Control

  • Downhill Assist Control

  • Tire Pressure Monitoring System

  • Front, Side & Curtain Airbags

  • LATCH Child Seat Anchors

Toyota engineered the Highlander with safety as a top priority. Vehicle Stability Control, Traction Control, and Brake Assist work together to enhance control in changing road conditions, while Hill Start Assist and Downhill Assist improve confidence on steep terrain.

The reinforced body structure and advanced airbag system provide excellent occupant protection for peace of mind on every trip.

Cargo & Versatility

  • Seating for Up to 7 Passengers

  • Fold-Flat Second & Third-Row Seats

  • Spacious Rear Cargo Area

  • Power Liftgate

  • Hidden Underfloor Storage

  • Roof Rails

  • Flexible Cargo Configurations

The Highlander Limited offers exceptional flexibility with generous cargo space and multiple seating configurations. Fold the second and third-row seats to create a large cargo area capable of carrying luggage, sports equipment, furniture, or camping gear.

Its spacious layout makes it ideal for growing families and active lifestyles.

Exterior Features

  • Limited Chrome Exterior Accents

  • 19-Inch Alloy Wheels

  • Power Moonroof

  • Roof Rails

  • Fog Lights

  • Heated Power Side Mirrors

  • Rear Privacy Glass

  • Power Liftgate

  • Chrome Door Handles

  • Signature Toyota Front Grille

The 2013 Highlander Limited features a sophisticated exterior with chrome accents, premium alloy wheels, and a bold front grille that reflects Toyota's timeless design. Roof rails, fog lights, and the power liftgate add both style and everyday convenience.

Its elegant yet rugged appearance makes it equally suited for city driving and weekend adventures.

Highlights

  • Powerful 270 HP 3.5L V6 Engine

  • Full-Time All-Wheel Drive (AWD)

  • Premium Leather Interior

  • Heated Front Seats

  • Power Moonroof

  • JBL Premium Audio System

  • Built-In Navigation

  • Smart Key with Push Button Start

  • Rearview Backup Camera

  • Power Liftgate

  • Seating for Up to 7 Passengers

  • Up to 5,000 lbs Towing Capacity

  • Legendary Toyota Reliability

Summary

The 2013 Toyota Highlander Limited AWD is a premium midsize SUV that combines dependable V6 performance, luxurious comfort, advanced technology, and exceptional versatility. With its spacious three-row interior, intelligent all-wheel-drive system, premium features, and Toyota's legendary reputation for reliability, it's an outstanding choice for families and anyone seeking a capable, comfortable SUV.

Whether you're looking for a dependable daily driver, a capable all-weather vehicle, or a family SUV ready for road trips and adventures, the 2013 Toyota Highlander Limited AWD delivers the perfect blend of luxury, practicality, and long-lasting value. Built with Toyota quality and engineered for years of dependable service, it's an SUV you can confidently enjoy for many miles to come.

ABS brakes, four-wheel independent suspension, and speed-sensing steering contribute to confident handling in various driving conditions.

The 2013 Honda Pilot EX-L represents a well-maintained three-row SUV designed for families and those who need reliable transportation with genuine passenger and cargo capacity. This gray model comes with a clean, one-owner Carfax report, giving you confidence in its history and prior care.

- AM/FM/CD Audio System with XM Radio
- Power driver and passenger seats
- Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry
- Exterior parking camera (rear)
- Heated front leather-trimmed seats
- Split folding rear seat for flexible cargo space
- Power moonroof
- 18" alloy wheels
- 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Dual front and side airbags with overhead airbags
- Automatic temperature control with dual front and rear zones
- Low tire pressure warning system
- Garage door transmitter (HomeLink)
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror

The Pilot is powered by a 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 5-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. This combination delivers solid performance while achieving 17 mpg in the city and 24 mpg on the highway, making it practical for both daily commuting and longer trips.

Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully appointed cabin with leather-trimmed seating, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, and multiple climate zones to keep all passengers comfortable. The automatic temperature control system, heated front seats, and rear air conditioning ensure everyone travels in comfort. Power windows, mirrors, and a power liftgate add convenience to everyday driving.

Safety features include four-wheel independent suspension, speed-sensing steering, and a comprehensive airbag system. The exterior parking camera provides helpful visibility when backing up, while electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain grip and stability in various driving conditions.

The split folding rear seats maximize versatility, allowing you to accommodate passengers or expand cargo space as needed. Combined with the third row seating, this Pilot gives you room for up to eight occupants, making it suitable for active families or commercial use.

We invite you to schedule a time to view this vehicle in person and take it for a test drive to experience its capabilities firsthand.

This 2013 Chevrolet Tahoe LT Z71 delivers the capability and comfort you need in a full-size SUV built for both on-road refinement and off-road performance.

- Second row captain's chairs with leather seating and recline function
- Backup camera with rear vision system
- DVD rear seat entertainment system
- Heated seats throughout
- Power liftgate
- Sunroof/moonroof
- Tri-zone automatic climate control
- Remote start and keyless entry
- Heavy-duty trailering package with integrated trailer brake controller
- Heavy-duty locking rear differential
- Off-road suspension package with specially-tuned shocks and jounce bumpers
- Z71 off-road appearance package
- 18-inch aluminum wheels with all-terrain tires
- Bose premium 9-speaker audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio

The 5.3L V8 engine provides dependable power whether you're navigating city streets or venturing onto challenging terrain. The four-wheel-drive system works seamlessly with the 2-speed active electronic transfer case and heavy-duty locking rear differential to give you the traction you need. City driving delivers 15 MPG while highway cruising achieves 21 MPG, balancing capability with efficiency.

Inside, you'll find a well-appointed cabin that prioritizes both functionality and comfort. The leather-appointed seating with heated front and second-row seats keeps passengers comfortable during longer journeys. The second-row captain's chairs provide convenient individual spaces, while the power liftgate makes loading cargo effortless. The multi-zone climate control system ensures everyone travels at their preferred temperature.

The Z71 package combines off-road engineering with practical features. The specialized suspension system, front and rear wheel flares, skid plate protection, and tubular assist steps prepare this Tahoe for adventure. Should you need towing capability, the heavy-duty trailering package supplies auxiliary transmission and engine oil coolers for added reliability.

Technology enhances your driving experience with the navigation system, SiriusXM satellite radio, rear seat DVD entertainment, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls. The rearview camera and park assist system support safer maneuvering in tight spaces.

This Tahoe LT Z71 represents a practical investment in a vehicle that performs across varying conditions and meets the demands of family travel and work requirements. Visit our showroom to see how this SUV can serve your lifestyle.

description:
This 2013 Honda Pilot EX-L in striking red offers a well-appointed three-row SUV designed for families and those who value versatility. With its 3.5L V6 engine delivering 18 city and 25 highway MPG, this Pilot provides the balance of capability and efficiency you need for daily driving and longer journeys.

- 7 Speakers with AM/FM/CD Audio System and XM Radio
- Heated Front Bucket Seats with Leather-Trimmed Seat Trim
- Power Moonroof
- 18" Alloy Wheels
- Rear Parking Camera
- Front Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control with Rear Air Conditioning
- Power Driver and Passenger Seats
- Remote Keyless Entry
- HomeLink Garage Door Transmitter
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Four-Wheel Independent Suspension
- Dual Front Impact and Side Impact Airbags with Overhead Airbags
- Split-Bench Third Row Seats with Split-Folding Rear Seat
- Power Liftgate
- Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls

The interior reflects the EX-L's commitment to comfort and convenience. Heated leather-trimmed front seats keep you warm during cooler months, while the power moonroof adds an open-air element to your drives. The dual-zone automatic climate control ensures both driver and passenger reach their preferred temperature, with dedicated rear air conditioning for those in back. Multiple storage solutions, including driver and passenger door bins and an overhead console, help keep your belongings organized throughout the cabin.

Safety and control are prioritized in this SUV's design. The four-wheel independent suspension works with electronic stability control and traction control to maintain composure on various road surfaces. A comprehensive airbag system includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, and overhead airbags. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and anti-roll bars fore and aft contribute to overall structural integrity. The rear parking camera assists with backing maneuvers, while low tire pressure warning keeps you informed about your vehicle's tire status.

The Pilot's practical three-row seating arrangement accommodates up to eight passengers, with the split-folding rear seat providing flexibility as your needs change. The power liftgate makes loading and unloading cargo effortless, whether you're transporting groceries, luggage, or recreational equipment. Power windows, door mirrors, and the power steering system enhance everyday usability.

Entertainment and navigation features keep occupants engaged during drives. The AM/FM/CD audio system with XM Radio and seven speakers delivers quality sound, while steering wheel mounted audio controls let you adjust settings without taking your eyes off the road. The trip computer and outside temperature display provide useful driving information, and the auto-dimming rear-view mirror with compass adds convenience to your commute.

This vehicle is located at Navarre Honda, 1320 East College Street, Lake Charles, LA 70607. Please call any of our Honda Sales Professionals at 337-337-2704 for more details or to set an appointment!

Visit our website http://www.navarrehonda.com for more our New, Pre-Owned, and HondaTrue Certified vehicle specials!

description:
This 2013 Chevrolet Equinox LT delivers reliable crossover capability with a practical design built for everyday driving.

- White Diamond Tricoat exterior finish
- 18" chrome-clad aluminum wheels
- Driver Convenience Package with remote vehicle starter
- 8-way power driver seat adjuster
- Chevrolet MyLink touch-screen display with AM/FM/SiriusXM
- Bluetooth connectivity for phone integration
- Rear backup camera
- Automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- Heated power door mirrors
- Split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo space
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- OnStar Directions & Connections emergency communication
- Black roof rack cross bars with integrated roof rails
- Remote keyless entry and panic alarm

The heart of this Equinox is its 2.4L 4-cylinder SIDI DOHC engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission with overdrive, delivering solid fuel efficiency with an EPA-estimated 22 mpg in the city and 32 mpg on the highway. This powertrain provides the balance of performance and economy that crossover buyers appreciate for both commuting and weekend trips.

The cabin features premium cloth seat trim with deluxe front bucket seats and a front center armrest for comfort during longer drives. The driver's seat offers power adjustment in eight directions, allowing you to find your ideal seating position. The telescoping and tilt steering wheel further enhances comfort and visibility for different drivers.

Safety is integrated throughout this crossover with dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and an occupant sensing system. Four-wheel disc ABS brakes with brake assist, combined with electronic stability control and traction control, work together to help maintain control in various driving conditions. The rear backup camera provides added visibility when reversing.

Practicality meets convenience with features like the split-folding rear seat that expands cargo versatility, the rear window wiper for improved visibility, and variably intermittent front wipers that adjust to weather conditions. Climate control is managed through a manual system with air conditioning and a rear window defroster to keep your interior comfortable year-round.

This Equinox represents a dependable choice for those seeking a capable crossover with established reliability and a well-appointed interior ready for your daily adventures.

The center armrest adds comfort during longer drives, and the oversized overhead console provides practical storage. Illuminated entry lighting and an outside temperature display enhance the user-friendly experience.

Safety systems provide confidence behind the wheel. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to help maintain vehicle control. The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front and side impact airbags plus knee and overhead protection, all monitored by an occupant sensing system. A low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about tire condition.

Practical features make this Santa Fe Sport ready for your lifestyle. The rear back-up camera helps with parking and reversing, while the tow hitch opens possibilities for recreational pursuits. Cargo management tools including a cargo cover and cargo net help keep your belongings secure and organized. Weather protection comes from the rear window wiper and variably intermittent front wipers.

This one-owner vehicle with verified Carfax history represents a solid value in the three-row SUV segment. With 68,307 miles, it has years of reliable service ahead. If youre looking for a capable family crossover with established dependability, we invite you to visit and explore this Santa Fe Sport in person.

This 2017 Lincoln MKC Premiere offers a refined driving experience combined with practical design, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a dependable compact luxury vehicle.

- 10-speaker audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio and CD player
- SYNC 3 communications and entertainment system
- Heated soft touch bucket seats with memory functions
- Dual-zone automatic temperature control
- High-intensity discharge headlights with automatic operation
- Exterior parking camera with rear parking sensors
- Power liftgate for convenient cargo access
- Heated power door mirrors
- Rear window defroster and wiper with speed-sensitive operation
- Roof rack with rails
- 18-inch painted aluminum wheels
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Electronic stability control with traction control
- Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS

The MKC Premiere comes equipped with comprehensive safety features, including dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, knee and overhead airbags, and a low tire pressure warning system. The vehicle's structural design includes front and rear anti-roll bars for enhanced stability during cornering, while the electronic stability control system actively helps maintain traction in varying road conditions.

Inside, the cabin presents a comfortable environment with heated front seats available in soft touch material and adjustable power functions for both driver and passenger. The front bucket seat design paired with a center armrest provides support for daily commuting, while the split folding rear seat allows flexibility for passenger or cargo configurations. Climate control comes through dual-zone automatic temperature regulation, ensuring comfort for all occupants regardless of personal preferences.

The 2.0-liter GTDi engine paired with a six-speed automatic transmission delivers capable performance for city and highway driving. With an EPA rating of 21 city and 28 highway miles per gallon, this front-wheel-drive platform balances efficiency with responsive driving dynamics. The power steering system adapts to vehicle speed, providing precise handling feedback while improving overall fuel economy.

Technology integration centers on the SYNC 3 system, which manages entertainment, navigation, and connectivity functions through voice commands and touchscreen controls. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep primary functions within easy reach, while the ambient lighting and overhead console enhance the overall interior presentation. Additional conveniences include a compass display, outside temperature readout, and a comprehensive trip computer for monitoring fuel consumption and trip statistics.

This MKC Premiere presents itself as a well-equipped compact luxury vehicle that prioritizes both driver comfort and practical functionality. With its gray exterior finish, proven powertrain, and comprehensive feature set, this Lincoln is ready for your transition to ownership.

This 2017 Nissan Rogue SL combines practical versatility with refined comfort for today's driver. As a local trade-in, this well-maintained crossover is ready to serve your family with dependable performance and thoughtful amenities.

- Android CarPlay and Apple CarPlay connectivity
- LED headlights with auto high-beam functionality
- Power panoramic moonroof
- All-wheel drive with Xtronic CVT transmission
- Leather appointed seat trim with heated front seats
- Rear backup camera with rear traffic alert
- SiriusXM satellite radio
- Blind spot warning system
- Bluetooth connectivity with USB port
- Navigation system
- Power liftgate
- Automatic temperature control with dual front zones
- Roof rack rails
- Chrome rear bumper protector with black splash guards

The Rogue SL features a 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with an Xtronic continuously variable transmission, delivering 25 city and 32 highway mpg. This efficient powertrain provides the balance of capability and fuel economy that practical families need for both daily commutes and weekend adventures. All-wheel drive comes standard, enhancing traction and stability in varying road conditions.

Inside, you'll find genuine leather seating throughout, with heated front bucket seats that offer comfort during colder months. The quick comfort heated steering wheel and memory driver seat further personalize your driving experience. The automatic temperature control system with separate front dual zones ensures everyone travels comfortably, while the rear window defroster keeps visibility clear.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily routine. Android CarPlay and Apple CarPlay bring your smartphone directly to the navigation system, while the nine-speaker sound system with AM/FM radio and SiriusXM satellite radio keeps entertainment flowing. Navigation guides your way, and Bluetooth connectivity keeps your calls hands-free and safe.

Safety features work quietly in the background. Blind spot warning alerts you to vehicles outside your line of sight, while rear traffic alert provides guidance when backing up. The rear backup camera gives you a clear view, and standard electronic stability control works with traction control to maintain grip on the road.

The gray exterior is enhanced by LED headlights with auto high-beam capability, ensuring visibility without manual adjustment. The power panoramic moonroof opens up the cabin to light and fresh air, while the chrome rear bumper protector and black splash guards add practical style and protection.

Visit our showroom to experience this thoughtfully equipped Rogue SL for yourself. Our team is ready to discuss how this capable crossover can fit your lifestyle.
